reason: Expert provides a troubleshooting tip for transmission traffic not recovering after SFP replacement despite normal status and optical levels.

knowledge.summary: After replacing an SFP on older transmission units where the interface is up and optical levels are normal but traffic does not pass, check if traffic counters are zero and bounce the interface.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Applies when interface status is UP, optical levels are OK, alarms are cleared, but traffic counters remain at zero.
